redactor_b4d8de1e.text: Good evening. Your heroes have been very brave. I have taken the liberty of making that unnecessary.

redactor_dd47de8a.text: The heroes caught outside their Fortress have lost their powers. The others may remain behind their shield. I can be patient.

redactor_6fdd44a1.text: My associates will attend to each district. Stay inside. If you hear someone calling for a hero, let them finish.

gravemark_54602e44.text: And any heroes who object can take it up with me. On the roof.

redactor_8d38b4d9.text: Sleep well. I know how much safer you feel when someone else is watching.

bastion_c36af370.text: The district relays are feeding his drain. Half our roster is down. Patch, can the Fortress shield hold?

patch_19791062.text: The shield holds. Inside, your powers are safe. Outside, he can target every signature on the hero register.

bastion_60e45571.text: And a way to fight back?

patch_3d25bf2f.text: I am looking for a way past his scanner. The coffee will have to wait.

echo_7091bd57.text: Then we need someone he has not registered. Someone new.

thorn_aefd5866.text: And someone willing to go. Knowing what waits outside.

halo_8722831d.text: We keep looking for an opening. Until then, we keep this city alive.

patch_b3fde7be.text: Uh. Small thing. Someone's climbing the outside of the Fortress.

volt_575d0d54.text: Hi! Sorry. Your front door has, like, nine locks.

volt_8b642679.text: I'm Volt. I'm a hero. Well... rookie hero. I saw the broadcast, and I want to help.

halo_c5594bf9.text: His lightning still works. No registered signature. Bastion, train him. Patch, fit him with an extraction beacon.

bastion_f9714a00.text: Training roof, through the Deploy Gate. Learn the kit first. Then we plan a route to the drain.

volt_2075047c.text: Right now? I just climbed sixty floors.

halo_01d9aff7.text: Halo on comms. I have your feed. I can channel a little light through your suit. Choose how to use it.

volt_e8d89ca7.text: Actual Halo backup. In my actual suit. Be cool, Volt. Be cool.

bastion_abe2bdee.text: Bastion on comms. Your suit has a shield channel. Take an upgrade and keep that relay in sight.

volt_c0193e2c.text: Right. Shield first. Heroic pose later.

bastion_9c4164aa.text: Just hold still and take the gear.

echo_be6749e5.text: Echo here. Your suit can carry a psychic signal. Mine. Try not to make this weird.

volt_945b1247.text: You are literally in my head. I think weird has arrived.

thorn_93e3e1ba.text: Thorn on comms. I know these relay crews. My roots can help you keep them off your back.

volt_85493767.text: Glad you are on this side of the call.

patch_fdce01af.text: Patch here. A supply locker is waiting on this roof. Choose one piece of kit.

volt_ed27beb9.text: I'll try to break it less.

patch_0d0119b6.text: You won't. But I appreciate the lie.

kilnheart_947f7ebe.text: Whoa, whoa. Hold up. You're the new kid? They sent the new kid?

kilnheart_2f0a5646.text: Kid, I've been running furnaces since before you had teeth. You know what happens to things that get too close to the fire?

kilnheart_8e06fce0.text: There they are. Feeling better? You were a little crispy last time.

volt_86ce591d.text: I'm fine. Totally fine. Thanks for asking.

kilnheart_3ff6d246.text: I wasn't asking. I was gloating. There's a difference.

kilnheart_87e192a6.text: You came back. Huh. Gotta be honest, I had money on you quitting.

kilnheart_361afd16.text: Myself. I lost. I'm taking it out on you.

kilnheart_288e7b7a.text: Okay. Last time. That was a fluke, right? Tell me that was a fluke.

kilnheart_a6a99fe1.text: Great. Love that. Really great for my reputation.

patch_1ac914b8.text: Volt, quick note. Kilnheart's suit runs at nine hundred degrees.

kilnheart_73ab998a.text: Is that the engineer? Hey! Nice work on the kid's suit. Real shame what's inside it.

patch_899e9be7.text: ...Okay, that one was a little bit funny.

volt_6fc211cb.text: Can I ask you something? Why him? Why work for the Redactor?

kilnheart_804f87f2.text: Twenty years I kept this city warm. Foundry shifts. Double shifts. Then they shut it down, and you know whose lights went out first?

kilnheart_8c0ae762.text: Ours. He's the first guy who ever handed something back.

volt_24707e85.text: He didn't hand it back. He's renting it to you.

kilnheart_7714eeae.text: So the rumour's true. The kid walked out of the tower.

kilnheart_66f30cb2.text: And yet here we are. Same roof. Same furnace.

kilnheart_d64eb789.text: Ever tried switching off a furnace halfway through a melt? Doesn't end well for anybody. Let's go.

bellwether_d24ec151.text: Everyone says that before the first song. Nobody says it after the encore.

bellwether_67042572.text: Back for night two? The reviews from night one were... mixed.

volt_e7b0fd5a.text: I went down on, like, the third song.

bellwether_a121c172.text: Fourth. You missed the bridge. It's the best part.

bellwether_5d6c2b9b.text: You know, most people who come to my shows buy a ticket.

volt_b99bb969.text: Most people don't get a choice about hearing them.

bellwether_d032d003.text: Ooh. A critic. I've eaten critics, sweetheart. Metaphorically. Mostly.

bellwether_e2c6cdc6.text: Last time. You found the gaps between the waves.

bellwether_49c5bb00.text: They were RESTS. They're called RESTS. They're a musical—

echo_8ef58508.text: Volt, I'm in Bellwether's head. It's... really loud in here.

bellwether_795efd97.text: Who is that? Get out of my headspace, there's no backstage access!

echo_8d4967a9.text: Go left when the bass drops. Also, they hum their own songs. Constantly.

volt_e39e9c1b.text: Why the speakers? Why make the whole city listen?

bellwether_5de1f69a.text: You know how many empty rooms I sang to? Ten years of open mics. Bartenders talking over me. Phones out.

volt_84974e48.text: That's not the same as somebody listening.

bellwether_9e49717b.text: ...Wow. You really know how to kill a vibe.

bellwether_3be82b74.text: The night you went into the tower, the whole city went quiet. Did you hear it?

bellwether_4a979129.text: I've never heard anything like it. It was horrible. It was... kind of beautiful.

bellwether_1c4c33de.text: Ugh. Forget I said that. From the top!

verdigris_c0fd776b.text: Mind the vines. They bite. Well. They don't bite. They just never let go.

verdigris_85882746.text: Everything on this roof is slowly becoming mine. The pipes. The rails. You, if you stand still long enough.

volt_2cc3736b.text: Noted. Moving a lot. Got it.

thorn_f006557f.text: Volt. Don't. Let me talk to them.

verdigris_b00ce3a1.text: Thorn? Thorn, is that you? On a hero frequency?

verdigris_78dc04f9.text: Oh, I need a minute. This is the best thing that's happened to me all year.

thorn_dc60c635.text: The Redactor's using you. Same way he used me.

verdigris_5ff1fd8d.text: And the heroes keep you in a glass box with a watering can. I've seen it, Thorn.

verdigris_60556472.text: Welcome back. There's still a little rust on your left shoulder. From last time.

verdigris_3f1ee93e.text: That's what everyone says right before they're compost.

verdigris_c43493e9.text: You keep coming back here like a weed.

verdigris_20745fa7.text: You cut me back last time.

verdigris_3367def0.text: Oh, no, I'm grateful. Plants grow back stronger when you prune them. You really should've read the manual.

verdigris_ffb430d9.text: Can I ask you something? Does Thorn still have the little green one? In the blue pot?

verdigris_4b7ef874.text: Because I gave it to them. Back when we still grew things that were alive.

volt_222bd7b0.text: It's doing okay. It's actually doing really well.

verdigris_89d2a170.text: ...Good. That's good. Now get off my roof.

verdigris_46b159bc.text: Something's changed since you went into the tower. The rust is slower. The vines are tired.

verdigris_e9ca1515.text: Sounds like the garden's changing. That's not the same thing.

glasswake_90cf841f.text: Hi. Over here. No, over here. No, you know what? Pick one. I'll wait.

volt_a47c2c59.text: How about I just hit all of you?

echo_684a417b.text: Volt. The real one's the only one actually thinking. The copies are empty.

glasswake_32646a43.text: Is that a mind reader? In my mirror maze? That's cheating.

echo_0e60622d.text: You're thinking about your hair right now.

volt_90733d97.text: I'm going to hit the one thinking about its hair.

glasswake_08eec4d1.text: Eleven. You hit my reflections eleven times last time. I counted.

glasswake_769c0f44.text: I had a lot of free time. You were lying down.

glasswake_5f716e65.text: You're back! And still looking at the wrong me. Honestly, it's kind of sweet.

glasswake_c6279376.text: Take your time. I've got plenty of me.

glasswake_955ae324.text: Do you know how long it takes to find all the pieces? I'm still missing an elbow.

volt_f6d3e6d6.text: What happens when the mirrors are gone? Who's left?

glasswake_cf4790ba.text: Nobody you'd look at twice. I know. I checked. For years, nobody looked twice.

volt_6ecc08a1.text: I'm looking. Just at you, though.

glasswake_1a810920.text: ...Okay, that's annoying. Stop being sincere at me. It's very off-putting.

glasswake_e56ba9a9.text: So the Redactor's gone. Or a reflection of him is. Are you sure which one you hit?

glasswake_602a4a1b.text: 'Pretty sure.' Adorable. That's how I get everybody.

undertow_e3048d54.text: Picked a bad night to go swimming, rookie.

volt_471d6900.text: I didn't really pick it. I kind of just... landed here.

undertow_f7519dd3.text: Story of this whole district. Nobody chooses the docks. The docks choose you.

undertow_ce87171d.text: Well, well. The old man's on comms. Still hiding up in your tower, Bastion?

bastion_e20cb739.text: I held these docks for six years.

undertow_17ea8e3f.text: And then you didn't. Funny how the water remembers that and you don't.

bastion_6cf5334f.text: Volt. Put this one on ice.

undertow_b8d09177.text: Nine seconds. That's how long you held your breath last time.

undertow_ba122f01.text: Not a lot else to do down here.

undertow_a2ab9b8c.text: Back in the water. Brave, or stupid?

undertow_1288e9f4.text: Most people do. Usually right before the stupid part wins.

undertow_0311248d.text: Last time you pulled me out of the water. Nobody's done that in a long time.

undertow_99ffe06d.text: Don't. Don't do the hopeful thing. The current hasn't changed.

volt_e9b983ae.text: Bastion said he used to guard this place. What happened?

undertow_142dcdb7.text: The city decided the docks weren't worth the budget. Pulled the heroes. Then the flood came, and nobody answered the call.

undertow_f6745cd8.text: The Redactor answered. Wasn't pretty. But he picked up.

undertow_4e384655.text: Yeah? Then prove it, rookie. Out here, sorry doesn't float.

undertow_afc3849b.text: Tide's turning. Feel that? The Redactor's grip is slipping.

undertow_9aa3ba1d.text: Not yet. Somebody's got to show me the water's safe first.

gravemark_d20d04df.text: Another small, loud hero on my roof. I have carved forty-one names. Yours will be forty-two.

volt_43ca42be.text: Can you at least spell it right? It's V-O-L-T.

gravemark_23cd763b.text: Halo. It has been a long time. You send children now?

halo_047edfc7.text: I sent someone better than me.

gravemark_50e35946.text: Your name is half carved. V. O. L.

volt_b4884823.text: Good. Tell the stone I said hi.

gravemark_d2a2fe60.text: Do not apologise. A stone that is never broken never learns its shape.

volt_d928673c.text: The forty-one names. Who were they?

gravemark_e97f982b.text: Heroes who climbed this roof before you. The city forgot them. I did not.

volt_6f389d7c.text: So you're kind of... a memorial?

gravemark_ec9a6a65.text: Do not make it sound kind. I am still going to crush you.

volt_0608d262.text: Sure. Sure. But it's a little bit kind.

gravemark_8c5c50b1.text: You climbed past me. Into the tower. I felt it when the Redactor fell. The whole roof felt it.

volt_0572aace.text: Is that why you're being quiet?

gravemark_8ec7e1fd.text: Even stone listens, little spark. Now. Again.

redactor_6506d425.text: Ah, Volt. Such a promising file. And one complaint I would like to discuss in person.

redactor_2a8cf135.text: Mine. You have mistaken my patience for permission to enter.

redactor_5ef5078d.text: You think the lightning makes you brave. I shall remove it, and we can meet the person underneath.

volt_2c8bafe8.text: Yeah, I'm going to have to decline.

redactor_878971ec.text: Of course you are. They all ask to keep something.

redactor_75177cac.text: A small question, Volt. Before we begin. Indulge me.

redactor_04dfa97e.text: Does Halo still stand on that balcony every night? Watching the city. Never looking down.

volt_3cc7f580.text: How do you know about the balcony?

redactor_c7a64760.text: Ask her who stood beside her. Watch her face when you do.

redactor_c7703c3e.text: You are breathing rather well, considering how we left things. Someone has been taking care of you.

volt_b5cd68d1.text: Yeah, I get that a lot.

redactor_a15e2922.text: I shall remember that. Someone ought to.

redactor_3fbb88c9.text: Persistence is not a power, Volt. It is simply fear that has not recognised itself yet.

redactor_75a0a3da.text: For the moment. I prefer to let a habit establish itself before I correct it.

redactor_b6cbf93b.text: I flagged your little victory. I have spent the interval learning exactly where you break.

redactor_bd93a30b.text: With pleasure. This time, I shall be thorough.

redactor_e64699b4.text: She has not told you. How considerate. She always did know what people could bear.

redactor_2083de34.text: Halo and I were partners. Then the tower fell. There was time to make one choice. She made it while I was still calling her name.

redactor_5206bb26.text: The city was saved. I was left beneath it. She found the distinction quite manageable.

redactor_9b78b1de.text: Redacted. There are things even she does not get to keep.

volt_4575efbf.text: Why do this? Why take everyone's powers?

redactor_4197797c.text: Because power lets a person decide who is worth saving. I have been on the other side of that decision.

redactor_0449b764.text: Take it away, and the choosing stops. Every life is equally fragile. Even hers.

redactor_7f97590e.text: Halo. I wondered how long you could bear to listen.

halo_17bd91ed.text: I'm not here for you. I'm here for him.

redactor_13a9ef31.text: Of course. There is always someone else to save while I am speaking.

volt_76b40537.text: Hey. Hi. Sorry. Can we save the reunion for after I punch him?

redactor_66e8933c.text: Twice you have left this room alive. You are beginning to mistake a pattern for a promise.

redactor_8e8295fb.text: Some rooms must be kept exactly as they were. She understands why.

volt_c05bcfe5.text: Halo? Hi! I mean, hey. Hi. Volt here.

halo_63cabc56.text: I know. I'm watching your feed.

volt_60f5c6bc.text: Cool. Cool cool cool. No pressure.

halo_835dbfe3.text: You fight like you've got something to prove.

halo_a97c734d.text: Not to me. To them. The ones watching from the windows.

halo_9a8779f7.text: Whatever he told you about me. Finish the fight first.

bastion_4ccb036f.text: You're being aggressive in the wrong direction. Here.

bastion_55ceb3bb.text: I've sent a lot of rookies out that gate.

bastion_2a5a3ea9.text: You keep bringing the gear back. Most rookies only bring excuses. Don't make it weird.

volt_04af766d.text: I wasn't going to ask anything.

echo_107270fb.text: You were going to ask if I'm reading your mind.

echo_f315509f.text: Can I tell you something weird?

echo_3b4f0945.text: Out there, your head goes really quiet. Focused. It's... nice.

thorn_7e3e87ee.text: No. Don't. They'd never forgive you if you did.

patch_907e5b96.text: Patch here. Your suit is currently held together by tape and optimism.

patch_139e8988.text: Fun fact. I've started naming your suit repairs.

bastion_155e5998.text: Three district relays feed the tower shield. Choose a route, beat their operators, and we can reach Gravemark.

volt_3a5b66a4.text: Three relays. One enormous doorman. Then the Redactor.

patch_ecdcb78f.text: Your suit can channel the team's power remotely. Choose the upgrades they offer. The link burns out when I extract you.

halo_7d6e50fa.text: He has our power signatures. Outside the Fortress shield, he can drain us. Yours is still unregistered. That gives you a chance.

volt_40d762e9.text: Finally. A useful reason for all my missing paperwork.

bastion_966c1021.text: If you go down, Patch pulls you out. We regroup, repair, and try another route. We do not leave you there.

halo_03da886b.text: Reach his control room. Shut down the drain. Bring the stolen power home.

patch_e8a6bab0.text: Extraction worked. Your borrowed upgrades burned out, but the permanent suit repairs held.

patch_eea59708.text: I changed your suit signature again. His scanners will have to start over.

bastion_2884ad88.text: His crews have reconnected the relays. We know more than we did last time. Pick our next route.

volt_6acd8699.text: Same job. Better plan. Preferably fewer dents.

bastion_3714b276.text: The main drain is down, but his backup relays are coming online. This is a new operation.

patch_aa8caf70.text: Fresh suit signature. Fresh support link. He does not get an easy lock on you.

halo_0d90a7af.text: You brought people's powers back. Now we keep them back.

volt_61addc4d.text: Then let's find the next switch.

patch_470a31c4.text: Three relays offline. The tower shield is open. Gravemark is the last guard between you and the control room.

volt_1a4fcbc7.text: Of course the last lock has fists.

bastion_5dd2c022.text: Gravemark is down. The Redactor is above you. Keep climbing.

halo_cc20fe64.text: Whatever he says, you are there to stop the drain. Stay on that.

patch_25c56ac4.text: The drain is offline. Stolen power is returning across the city.

halo_2ca29426.text: Escaped through his backup network. You stopped this operation. We will find the rest.

bastion_305e8941.text: Extraction inbound. Bring our rookie home.

halo_c8bae87c.text: You made it inside. Keep listening to Bastion and we might keep you alive.

volt_52dbaccd.text: Still getting used to being in here. Huge fan. I mean, ready to work.

halo_83ba9204.text: You volunteered before you understood the danger. I need you to understand it now.

halo_b79b0b8e.text: Train first. Then help us shut down the drain.

volt_1a3aecca.text: Is it true? You left him in the tower?

halo_028ccddf.text: The tower was coming down. Half the district was still inside. I could reach him, or I could reach them.

halo_7a341e66.text: I've stood on this balcony every night since, making sure it was the right call.

halo_be9c5721.text: I chose the people I could reach. That saved lives. It does not make leaving him hurt less.

volt_ef9239b3.text: He asked if you still stand out here. And who used to stand here with you.

halo_ab66774d.text: You walked out of the Redactor's tower.

volt_506a9e57.text: I did! I mean. Yes. I did that.

halo_3c8d96a7.text: I knew someone once who'd have said I was wrong about you.

volt_444906be.text: You put it down once, right? How?

halo_ac0ffdb2.text: I didn't. It got back up. They always get back up.

volt_f7a4ccd3.text: Did you see? Did you see the part where I—

halo_babd78ea.text: Everyone does, the first hundred times.

halo_1fc6f0e6.text: Most rookies have quit by now.

bastion_305054a7.text: Volt. Before you deploy, learn where everything is.

bastion_525d3cbf.text: Workshop's left. Armoury's right. Gate's at the bottom. My table is in the middle. Don't touch it.

bastion_4d59e8f3.text: Undertow told you about the docks.

volt_0ea362cb.text: Is it true? You just... left?

bastion_bc01f294.text: I have regretted it every single day since.

bastion_381b2fc3.text: If you tell Echo, you're on toilet duty for a year.

volt_114ca2b7.text: An actual licence? With my name on it?

bastion_00860129.text: Take it to the armoury. And don't frame it.

bastion_ad7df111.text: Pulled the footage from your last operation.

bastion_436d6a4a.text: The cause is on your run report. Learn the tell before the next deployment.

volt_05bfb0f5.text: I had it. I had it right up until I didn't have it.

bastion_1b289135.text: That's what everyone says. Watch for the tell next time.

bastion_93ec3cc2.text: Updated the map. One district back.

volt_5c5b69f4.text: Can I put the marker on? Please?

bastion_bded3917.text: Rule one: block what you can read.

bastion_ab7b88b4.text: Stop asking how many rules there are.

echo_e9735f17.text: Volt. I know. I read your file. I read everyone's file.

volt_056f8dd5.text: You read minds. That's not reading a file.

volt_9f2d35ff.text: I noticed. You were very smug about it.

echo_5ab8290d.text: I'm always smug. That was premium smug.

echo_86337efa.text: Don't look at me like that.

echo_dd5db8e5.text: Like you won and you want me to say it.

volt_ed49975c.text: Decent? I took back a whole district!

echo_d6ccfaeb.text: I would. And I'd have looked better doing it.

echo_5725d234.text: I saw the strike too late. By the time I called, you were already down.

volt_c9623dfe.text: And you didn't think to warn me?

echo_778e32bb.text: I did. The relay interference swallowed the warning.

echo_bda0db28.text: Next time I call earlier. You listen earlier. Deal?

echo_09763584.text: That's either really brave or really stupid. I'm still reading which.

thorn_8d482764.text: Thorn. And yes. I was one of them.

volt_d329e829.text: The one in the blue pot. They said they gave it to you.

thorn_12c2183f.text: They did. Back when we still grew things that were alive.

thorn_dbebbcc1.text: I'm keeping it going until they want it back.

thorn_3d26d32a.text: Plants are patient. So am I.

thorn_d7d64d96.text: Their vines were never alive. Mine are. That's the whole difference.

thorn_92a284b8.text: Plants get cut back. Then they grow back stronger.

thorn_c1e110ce.text: It's botany. Take it however you like.

thorn_9ee5ab4a.text: Half this Fortress still watches me like I'm going to turn.

volt_f531135b.text: They watch me like I'm going to trip.

patch_a6a558bc.text: Depends on the night. The terminal's for upgrades. Shards go in, a better you comes out.

patch_ccfb92b5.text: A slightly better you. Let's be realistic.

patch_c7072d4b.text: You've got shards just sitting there.

patch_c3f54c1d.text: It's an observation. A pointed one. Terminal's right there.

patch_4440b468.text: Don't thank me. Thank the forms. There were nine.

patch_d1232b3a.text: Your suit beacon tripped last operation. I pulled you out before the signal died.

patch_509bb535.text: It looked dramatic. I've patched it. That's repair number...

patch_ad336741.text: I've lost count. Let's call it 'again'.

halo_e3181463.text: The city doesn't sleep. Neither do I.

bastion_ffd0189a.text: Still here? Good. Now be somewhere else.

echo_7997d13e.text: I'm training. Want to spar? No? Smart.

echo_dd7e278a.text: You're thinking really loud right now.

echo_9cb43fb8.text: Yes. The gate's that way. You were about to ask.

thorn_fd1fbe4e.text: This is the only quiet spot in the Fortress. Don't ruin it.

thorn_6ab3499b.text: Go on. The city won't wait.

patch_c262e5a9.text: Busy. Talk to the terminal, it's friendlier.

patch_31c9692d.text: Comms are green. Go break something that isn't mine.

patch_56899b65.text: Are you leaning on my workbench?

bastion_07f9aa96.text: Let's see you move. And no climbing anything.

bastion_fb61a41a.text: That dummy's survived forty rookies. Ruin its streak.

bastion_de2f7e95.text: Now your Special. Every style's is different. Let's find out what yours does.

bastion_adcef830.text: Dash. You're untouchable for half a second. Make the half second count.

bastion_b4841e24.text: Watch the white ring. Tap Block as it closes. A parry stops damage, reflects shots, resets your dash and charges Overload. Now catch one.

bastion_54b4d385.text: That took a chunk of his Composure. Strikes chip it away. Parries crush it. Empty the gold bar and he staggers for three seconds. Your hits deal double damage.

bastion_bf3388f5.text: Last ones. Then you're on the clock for real.

kilnheart_bfcfea35.text: Back already? I only just scraped your confidence off the furnace.

kilnheart_a56b481b.text: Same jacket? Brave choice. It was medium-well when you left.

kilnheart_787d4bf6.text: I remember you. The rookie with the excellent smoke alarm impression.

bellwether_97826ba4.text: My favourite returning audience. You spent the last encore on the floor.

bellwether_b69f217c.text: You came back! The reviews said my last performance was absolutely flattening.

bellwether_618ade4f.text: No need to bow this time, darling. Last time you never got back up.

verdigris_4571e01d.text: Oh, you survived the compost heap. Most things come back as tomatoes.

verdigris_ee3b46fc.text: Your little dent in the moss is still here. I kept it watered.

verdigris_ef34999d.text: Welcome back. The vines have been asking about their favourite chew toy.

glasswake_4a573957.text: I remember that face. So do all my reflections. We had a lovely laugh.

glasswake_88f13c39.text: Back for another look? Last time the floor got most of your attention.

glasswake_1b0ad5de.text: Do try hitting the right one. Watching you lose to my reflection was embarrassing for both of us.

undertow_fc9e7fc0.text: Back again? I've had driftwood put up more of a fight.

undertow_5cd3c950.text: You left a lovely Volt-shaped dent on my dock. Mind stepping in it again?

undertow_5533ca65.text: I remember you. All that lightning, and you still went out like a wet match.

gravemark_403346fe.text: I remember you. The roof remembers you. The dent is still there.

gravemark_483821a1.text: Your name is already carved. This saves time.

gravemark_e08db610.text: You return. The stone remains unimpressed.

redactor_55cdb0b7.text: Volt. You remember the floor, I trust. You were so reluctant to leave it.

redactor_64368895.text: I wondered whether you would return. Recovery can do such unkind things to a person's judgment.

redactor_a7df799a.text: You have rehearsed what you will say to me. How touching. Last time, you became very quiet.

halo_4c1366ed.text: Rookie. The city's watching tonight, and so am I. Take this.

halo_0302aeea.text: Light doesn't bend for anyone. Neither should you.

bastion_946067ff.text: Shield channel ready. Choose the reinforcement you need for this roof.

bastion_7462e523.text: Hold the line. Let them break on you.

bastion_8775498b.text: Less flash, more footwork. Take this.

echo_03e7422d.text: Heard you were struggling. Loudly. Want help? Don't answer, I already know.

echo_8963629a.text: I read your next move. It was bad. Try this instead.

echo_967d4bde.text: Stop thinking so loud and pick one.

thorn_8dd5e6c9.text: They don't trust me at the Fortress either. Guess we have that in common.

thorn_ae159419.text: Nature doesn't rush. It just wins.

thorn_77dcf42a.text: Let them come to you. Then don't let them leave.

patch_37bde316.text: Patch here. I stashed a Fortress tech locker on this roof. One item, rookie.

patch_41a148ec.text: Tech locker's open. Don't break anything.

patch_64a11053.text: Pick one. I'm not made of prototypes.

halo_be249ad3.text: I'm not here to hold your hand. I'm here to make sure it's steady.

halo_dea58bc8.text: Every hero starts somewhere. Yours is this roof.

halo_eac68f20.text: Take it. Use it. Don't make me watch you waste it.

halo_f700ea50.text: The city doesn't need perfect. It needs you upright.

halo_38f52862.text: You're running on fumes. Take this, and stop bleeding.

halo_864dec84.text: I've seen that look before. In a mirror. Take this.

halo_ed5c6716.text: You've come further than most. Don't stop now.

halo_03b1a007.text: The Redactor's tower is close. I can see it from here. So can you.

halo_600ba391.text: Not a scratch. Show-off. Keep it up.

halo_48921c8c.text: Clean parries. Somebody's been paying attention.

halo_219fb88b.text: Kilnheart burns hot and fast. Be faster.

halo_a8f4dec0.text: Bellwether loves an audience. Don't give them one.

halo_68ca3db6.text: Verdigris wants you slow. Don't be.

halo_58b09671.text: Glasswake lies with light. I don't. Trust this.

halo_f7eb5f12.text: Undertow drags people down. Keep your head up.

halo_fde67617.text: Gravemark. Of course. Take this, and don't let it pin you.

halo_b48a2e7a.text: The control room is ahead. Shut down the drain, then get clear.

bastion_b918bb7b.text: Gear check: you're still in one piece. Good.

bastion_23b4aa33.text: Rule two: hit them before they hit you.

bastion_c1e1dd13.text: I've seen worse rookies. Not many. Some.

bastion_2eff7f59.text: Stand your ground. Here's something to stand on.

bastion_96f4b61f.text: Don't make me come down there.

bastion_2246c2a6.text: You're bleeding out there. Defensive gear, now.

bastion_b58f0532.text: Back off, reset, go again. That's an order.

bastion_955c32c0.text: Medic's a long way off, rookie. This'll have to do.

bastion_604a515f.text: Deep in their territory now. Stay sharp.

bastion_cabb7885.text: Long night. Longer if you get sloppy.

bastion_9e975ee9.text: No hits taken. Don't let it go to your head.

bastion_a39295a5.text: Textbook parries. I'll pretend I didn't see, so you don't get cocky.

bastion_8873c3ac.text: Kilnheart telegraphs everything. Read the wind-up.

bastion_ad3b9434.text: Watch the gaps in Bellwether's rings. Move through them.

bastion_2724ca1b.text: Keep moving. Verdigris turns standing still into a death sentence.

bastion_62d49b44.text: Glasswake's copies don't think. Hit the one that does.

bastion_49e2befe.text: Undertow's on my old docks. Make him pay for every metre.

bastion_43b1a41a.text: Gravemark hits like a building. Don't be standing there.

bastion_738b7b43.text: Final push. Everything we've got is behind you.

echo_fe0b80c9.text: You were about to ask for help. Don't. Just take it.

echo_593a3ca6.text: I've seen how this goes. You'll want this one.

echo_5ee44b48.text: Pick the left one. ...Kidding. Pick whatever.

echo_24838c2a.text: Your brain is very busy right now. Here's something simpler.

echo_3471bf6a.text: I'm not saying I'm worried. I'm saying here.

echo_3b6b89f1.text: Your thoughts are getting fuzzy. That's the blood loss. Take this.

echo_1dc304cd.text: Okay. I'm actually worried. Don't tell anyone.

echo_4a2ac326.text: Almost there. I can hear the tower humming.

echo_3a29c124.text: You're tired. I can tell. Your inner monologue got shorter.

echo_33f61bdf.text: Not a single hit? Who are you and what did you do with Volt?

echo_1d4df732.text: Okay, those parries were decent. I'd have done them faster.

echo_8ae12614.text: Bellwether's head is all bass. Go left when it drops.

echo_31b52f3d.text: Verdigris is so patient it's creepy. Be impatient.

echo_9af40945.text: The real Glasswake is the one thinking about their hair. Trust me.

echo_6b1c1cbc.text: Undertow keeps thinking about the docks. Use it.

echo_a747c893.text: Gravemark's mind is just rock grinding. Loud, slow rock.

echo_cf84e3d7.text: His mind's a locked filing cabinet. Hit it anyway.

thorn_73d67a92.text: Grow where you're planted. Even on a rooftop.

thorn_a93a7554.text: Patience is a weapon. Use it.

thorn_f6f03665.text: Quiet night. Let's keep it that way. Mostly.

thorn_5b726acc.text: I don't call much. When I do, take what I'm giving.

thorn_605664f0.text: Even burned forests grow back. Hold on.

thorn_f508f957.text: Deep roots now. Don't pull up.

thorn_ab74c7fd.text: Clean work. The ferns would be proud.

thorn_71c03760.text: You're learning to wait for the right moment. Good.

thorn_a7cb5ee6.text: Fire and plants don't mix. Stay out of the heat.

thorn_3fddec32.text: Even sound has roots. Cut them.

thorn_f9101d11.text: Verdigris. Don't hold back on my account.

thorn_df2756b2.text: Water's good for roots. Not for you. Keep moving.

thorn_68991c27.text: Stone cracks when roots get in. Find the cracks.

thorn_b4f7b4eb.text: He took my powers once. Don't let him take yours.

patch_788beb88.text: Fresh from the bench. Some of it was even tested.

patch_4f468b8a.text: Fortress tech, still warm. Literally. Don't lick it.

patch_ca5ce3d7.text: I fought Bastion for this budget. Choose wisely.

patch_0fad3fe3.text: Upgrade time. Try to bring the parts back in one piece.

patch_e85afbd0.text: Your suit's flashing red. That's bad. Here's something less bad.

patch_b273120a.text: Deep in the city now. Comms are getting patchy. Pun intended.

patch_4b5cc1b7.text: Zero damage reports. Are you even out there?

halo_e46feb23.text: So you're the rookie everyone keeps talking about. Show me why.

bastion_0b87fa9d.text: Bastion. I hold this city's line. Tonight I'm holding yours.

echo_c3d466ff.text: Echo. I already know how this ends. You're going to need me.

thorn_b8cc0708.text: Thorn. I used to be on the other side. Turns out I'm better at this one.

patch_381f5efa.text: Patch. I build the gear, you break it. Try not to break yourself.

volt_68f07a45.text: Then I'll just have to turn you off.

volt_1eda7208.text: Let's see who burns out first.

volt_8a05c585.text: Funny. I was about to say the same about your music.

volt_28707e84.text: Same song again? Change the record.

volt_9118e26f.text: I'm cutting the power to the speakers.

volt_8bb21ed9.text: Then I'll scrape every roof clean.

volt_7343b215.text: Then I'll just hit all of you.

volt_f2344026.text: Smash enough mirrors and you find the real one.

volt_45686a3d.text: Seven years' bad luck? I'll risk it.

volt_36cb431a.text: Good thing I don't plan on standing still.

volt_2f2de50e.text: I've been practising holding my breath.

volt_5dea148f.text: Electricity and water. You sure about this?

volt_db8f53ff.text: Carve it big. You'll want everyone to read it.

volt_fea415d4.text: Back on your roof. Miss me?

volt_1ce4b4cd.text: Let's see which of us cracks first.

volt_0394d6c5.text: Halo? THE Halo? ...I won't let you down.

volt_ccdb45aa.text: Then I'll hold the roof. Thanks, Bastion.

kilnheart_bcab0749.text: Feel that heat? That's the city's pressure, and I'm the valve. Step closer, rookie.

kilnheart_3d593e4f.text: The furnace never cools. Neither do I.

kilnheart_38a874b0.text: You again? I'll stoke the fire.

kilnheart_862215f5.text: You call that heat? I've had kettles put up more of a fight.

kilnheart_c01e3c51.text: Pressure finds every crack, rookie. You're all cracks.

kilnheart_83dcfcd8.text: Run back to your Fortress. Tell them the furnace is still lit.

bastion_3b8f3ae2.text: Kilnheart telegraphs every punch. When the white ring closes, block it and make her pay.

echo_ae544e55.text: She charges in a straight line. Step sideways, not backwards. Or parry it and watch her fold.

halo_9e1b8dd7.text: Get out of the disk first, then thread between the embers. Or knock the embers back at her.

halo_10a7ed7e.text: Those embers can be parried. Send them back where they came from.

thorn_d1aa9a2a.text: Don't fight on scorched ground. Pull her somewhere cooler.

bellwether_f016a8bc.text: Hear that? That's the whole city humming my song. You're just a wrong note.

bellwether_96d88b5d.text: Encore? Fine. Try to keep the beat this time.

bellwether_596bf876.text: Same stage, same rookie. Let's turn it up.

bellwether_976872f8.text: Feel the bass, Volt. Then fall to it.

bellwether_32a57425.text: Off-beat from start to finish. Painful to listen to.

bellwether_4d0f8497.text: You never found the gaps. Everyone finds the gaps.

bellwether_5b6993ab.text: That's a wrap, rookie. No encore for you.

echo_96c4c059.text: Her rings always have gaps, and they line up before they fire. Walk into one and let the sound pass.

bastion_02923fea.text: Focused Burst is a straight cone with a glint. Parry it and her speakers choke.

thorn_aa4238af.text: The resonators mark the ground first. Two spots, never more. Step off them.

verdigris_5ac84c44.text: Rust always wins, rookie. Every roof in this city is already mine. It just doesn't know it yet.

verdigris_951e6c01.text: Everything you build, I grow through.

verdigris_aedd7be3.text: Mind your step. The roof is hungry.

verdigris_40337ed4.text: You let my garden grow. Shame.

verdigris_dc3a57b3.text: Rust takes everything eventually. You just went first.

thorn_08a053b0.text: She aims the seeds at you. Bait them to the edges so the middle stays clean.

thorn_18f4a374.text: Never fight standing in acid. Rotate around the roof and keep the centre clear.

bastion_912957d2.text: The vine sweep has a white tell. Parry it, or just get behind her.

echo_4664e47b.text: Break the buds before they bloom. All three, and she's wide open.

glasswake_2cf783de.text: Which one of me are you looking at? Doesn't matter. You'll be wrong either way.

glasswake_3eaa97e4.text: Seen through me yet? No? Thought not.

glasswake_19fd1de3.text: You hit my reflection three times. Flattering, really.

glasswake_c11e6d96.text: Easy to beat someone who can't see straight.

glasswake_305ed3e7.text: Next time, look before you leap. Or don't. I enjoy this.

halo_0c169b9a.text: Three beams, always the same spread. Stand between them, or behind her.

bastion_aa63fe1d.text: She shows you where she's landing. Don't be standing there.

echo_ddb2e523.text: The real one has the solid white ring. Hit the decoys and their beams vanish, but every warned beam still hurts.

bastion_da59be28.text: Only the real Glasswake lunges. Parry it and her glass cracks.

undertow_c89f4124.text: The tide always comes in, rookie. Stand still and it'll take you with it.

undertow_b9fc535a.text: Back in the water? Brave. Or stupid.

undertow_47e5fed1.text: Pressure builds. It always breaks something.

undertow_ab9d89ca.text: Let's see how long you can hold your breath.

undertow_a1d70cd3.text: Washed out. Like I said you would be.

undertow_3a2d5e60.text: Cold, isn't it? You'll get used to it at the bottom.

undertow_2cd8b6ee.text: The docks keep what they catch.

echo_36805d6d.text: The jet shows its whole sweep before it fires. Get behind him or outside the arc. Ice blocks it too.

halo_605b6228.text: Depth Charges slow you. Leave the circle early: getting hit while slow snowballs.

bastion_154200fe.text: The hook has a white tell. Parry it and his gauntlet cracks wide open.

gravemark_11181a1d.text: Another rookie on my roof. I'll carve your name next to the others.

gravemark_aee999e1.text: Every fall makes you lighter. Every stone makes me heavier.

gravemark_93dad802.text: Back again? Then stay down this time.

gravemark_d05fc740.text: Is this what the Fortress sends now? I've crushed sturdier gravel.

gravemark_52f77eff.text: Little spark. You flickered, and then you went out.

gravemark_b7267b4d.text: Run home to your heroes. Tell them Gravemark sends its regards.

gravemark_77ca6c98.text: The roof will remember you. As a stain.

bastion_a9721278.text: That rock cannon telegraphs a straight lane. Parry the rock and it goes right back at Gravemark.

echo_e9bc25b5.text: The rubble circles before it flies. Stay outside the orbit, then slip between the spokes.

halo_b05d7691.text: The pull is weak. Walk against it, or dash out before the centre detonates.

thorn_5fd53476.text: The ring always leaves one way out, and it points at where you stood. Or hug Gravemark: the middle is safe.

redactor_f05dffa2.text: Powers are a privilege, rookie. I decide who keeps them. Tonight, I'm revoking yours.

redactor_dd1224bc.text: You again. Persistence is not a power.

redactor_7040f6c5.text: Let's see what's left of you after the edit.

redactor_6ac7efad.text: Did you really think the city would let you keep that spark?

halo_89b4ffeb.text: His lanes are always a third of a circle apart. Live in the wide gaps between them.

bastion_dd757158.text: Final Verdict gives you two ways out, then a second warning. Read both.

halo_8e1f0555.text: District by district, and Gravemark in the dirt. The city noticed tonight. So did I.

bastion_caaf8df0.text: Clean work, rookie. Don't let it go to your head. The next roof won't be so kind.

echo_9572d181.text: Okay. Fine. That was impressive. Don't tell anyone I said that.

halo_203b44f8.text: Not bad. I've seen worse first years. I was one of them.

thorn_da1768a9.text: You fight like someone with something to prove. Good. Keep proving it.

bastion_5c3530e8.text: Solid. Now do it again without the close calls.

halo_3689df37.text: Heroes aren't measured by how they fall. Get up. Again.

thorn_98197f30.text: I spent years on the wrong side of this fight. Losing isn't the end. Quitting is.

echo_c8d76bac.text: I'd have lasted longer. Probably. ...That was decent, I guess.

bastion_e3477cf8.text: You hesitated. Hesitation gets people hurt. Dash first, think second.

bastion_f099c668.text: Watch the coral arc. When the pipe goes back, you go sideways.

echo_c3e57de0.text: Those drones telegraph like bad poker players. Watch the amber line, then move.
